messages:
meena: Quick heads-up from onboarding support: several new users hit an error running starter-samples/node with json_mode + strict schema when a tool returns no body. Schema validator complains 'expected object got string'.

tobias: Can you paste the raw response/log snippet?

meena: Logged raw from the SDK: ""{}"" or sometimes ""[]"" after a retry. Python starter sample returns {} consistently.

anya: Odd. Which SDK helper handles tool output normalization in node?

meena: `packages/node-sdk/src/helpers/normalizeToolOutput.ts` — it does `try JSON.parse` then falls back to `raw`. But there's a retry interceptor that captures the response for dev logs and calls `JSON.stringify({payload: body})`. If `body` is already a string we end up with extra quoting.

tobias: Repro steps I used: stub tool to return 204/empty, run starter-samples/node with `REDWOOD_JSON_MODE=true REDWOOD_STRICT_SCHEMA=true` and call `client.call({ model: 'redwood-lite', json_mode: true, tool: 'meta' })`. Fails 100%.

meena: Workaround for onboarding: we added a tiny post-coerce in the starter sample that does: `if (typeof out === 'string') { try { out = JSON.parse(out); } catch(e){ out = {}; } }`

anya: That's fine short-term but we should fix in SDK. Plan: (1) tighten normalizeToolOutput to strip a single level of surrounding quotes and attempt parse again before falling back, (2) stop stringifying captured bodies in the retry/interceptor logging path (use base64 or separate field), (3) add a small parity e2e that runs node+py starter samples with stubbed tool to assert outputs match.

tobias: I'll own 1 + unit tests. Pushed branch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/node-sdk/pull/3012 — adds quote-trim guard and tests for 204 empty-body (expects {}) and for quoted-array variants.

meena: I'll open a quick PR to starter-samples to include the post-coerce fallback and a note in the quickstart README so workshop leads are unblocked.

ci-bot: Created ticket DEVEX-7000: "node-sdk normalizeToolOutput: handle quoted empty-tool payloads + retry logging audit" (assignee: tobias).

anya: Also adding a sample-quickstarts CI job that runs both runtimes against a stubbed tool and diffs outputs. Filing DEVEX-7001 for that.

tobias: Merged SDK fix to main, cherry-picked to v0.9.x and cut v0.9.1 patch. Added unit tests.

meena: Verified v0.9.1 fixes the onboarding crash; starter sample no longer needs the post-coerce hack. Leaving a short note in onboarding checklist to upgrade to v0.9.1.

devex-bot: DEVEX-7000 status: resolved (assignee: tobias). DEVEX-7001 opened for parity CI.

anya: Closing thread — will follow up if any quoted-base64 variants are reported.
